scope: Main-muzzle ammunition support, not whole reference equipment-recovery parity
finding: compatibleMagazines weapon merges all muzzles. Underbarrel grenades could satisfy receiver spare count or donor surplus and be transferred instead of primary rifle ammunition.
implementation: Prefer configured this muzzle, otherwise first named configured muzzle; use compatibleMagazines [weapon,muzzle].
Empty compatible set skips donor enumeration.
Keep twenty-second cadence, two-transfer maximum, receiver capacity/proximity and measured removed-round accounting. No reload or weapon-selection command.
cost: One config muzzle-array lookup per receiver evaluation at existing cadence; no world query, cache, timer or worker. Runtime overhead unmeasured.
remaining: Physical multi-muzzle/modded weapon inventory exchange and runtime acceptance absent.
Custom named-muzzle ordering follows first configured muzzle; no universal weapon-semantic classifier claimed.
LAMBS casualty equipment recovery remains a distinct incomplete source contribution.
